spans.text: [42] AR: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ EN: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

folded.id: screaming wind|on|a day of continuous misfortune
folded.subject: screaming wind

spans.text: [19] AR: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ EN: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
[15] AR: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
[17] AR: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
[22] AR: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
[32] AR: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
[40] AR: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
[51] AR: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
[23] AR: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ EN: Thamud denied the warning
The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

folded.id: the fire|on|their faces [it will be said]
folded.subject: the Fire

spans.text: [48] AR: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ EN: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
[1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ EN: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

folded.id: the hour|is|more disastrous and more bitter
folded.subject: the Hour

spans.text: [46] AR: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ EN: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
[46] AR: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ EN: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
[1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ EN: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
[17] AR: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
[22] AR: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
[32] AR: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
[40] AR: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ EN: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
[28] AR: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ EN: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

[42] AR: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ EN: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
[26] AR: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ EN: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
[2] AR: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ EN: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."

folded.id: under our|observation|as reward for he who had been denied
folded.subject: under Our
folded.object: as reward for he who had been denied

spans.text: [14] AR: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ EN: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
[27] AR: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ EN: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
[16] AR: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ EN: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
[18] AR: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ EN: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
[21] AR: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ EN: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
[30] AR: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ EN: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

[37] AR: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ EN: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
[39] AR: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ EN: So taste My punishment and warning.
[43] AR: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ EN: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
